topic: Properties and Phase Changes of Matter
key_concepts: Matter is classified into solid, liquid, and gas
Solids have definite shape and weight
Liquids take the shape of their container and can flow
Gas molecules are free and bouncing
Objects can be grouped by texture, shape, size, and weight
Weight can be compared using scales or balances
Temperature changes can cause physical changes in matter
Melting is the change from solid to liquid
Freezing is the change from liquid to solid
Evaporation and condensation are changes between liquid and gas
Sublimation and deposition are changes between solid and gas
Cooling can harden melted materials like candle wax or butter
